posts.headline: Twelve editions deep and Thicks is still 3-0, but all that championship pedigree and 403.68 points is a soft stroll, not a statement — Klint's Clipboard is winning like a team trying not to get noticed.
posts.detail: A title-holder at 3-0 should be running up the score, not quietly hovering mid-pack in points-for while this column keeps waiting for the actual crown-worthy week.

posts.headline: Twelve straight editions of burying Put it in Ra and the dig just got deeper — One Nut Barner's gaudy 20-8, 1.5-average-finish résumé is now an 0-3 punchline wearing a contender's jersey.
posts.detail: A career win pct of .714 and back-to-back title-game finishes has produced exactly zero wins through three weeks — this is the most historic collapse this column has ever chronicled.

posts.headline: talentedtenthh drops to 1-2 and Chauncey's 4-10, 12th-place career ledger is doing exactly what it always does — living down to the irony of his own team name.
posts.detail: 333.36 points and a bottom-feeder pedigree with an avgFinish of 12 means this isn't a slow start, it's just Tuesday for the untalented tenth.

posts.headline: Sasinci claws to 2-1 but Big Head's title banner stays dusty — a 13-15 career record and an avgFinish of 5.5 means Saso needs a lot more than this to shut up the Milk Man jokes.
posts.detail: 387.28 points is respectable, but a ring from two years ago doesn't cover for a .464 career win pct — prove it before the next quitting threat.

author.name: Easy way or the Hard Way

posts.headline: Easy way or the Hard Way stays winless at 0-3 and the league-worst 233.78 points confirms Auntie Thomas's 10-average-finish résumé isn't rebuilding, it's a reunion tour.
posts.detail: Three straight editions of basement-dwelling and this bottom-feeder's .429 career win pct still can't find daylight through three weeks.
